purpose: Deterministic verification of finite-roster outer-bound algebra, not empirical inference or novelty assessment.
knowledge_before_run: Sorting formulas, endpoint compatibility and the nesting inequality were derived before verification.
data: Synthetic rational-number interval/status fixtures only; no cell data or fitted outcomes.
single_horizon_reference: Exhaustive subset and interval-endpoint enumeration of the closed rectangular relaxation, using exact rational arithmetic.

nested_horizon_grid.enumeration: All compatible nested binary selection vectors with nonempty later selection and all interval-endpoint vectors; the same vector of path probabilities is used for both horizons.
nested_horizon_grid.checks: Every enumerated contrast lies within marginal subtraction and its intersection with the count-only nesting bound. Selected zero endpoints are admitted solely as the closure relaxation.

additional_controls: One founder selected at both horizons has exact zero contrast despite loose marginal subtraction
Nested selections can yield either positive or negative contrasts
tolerance: Exact Fraction arithmetic; zero numerical tolerance needed.
failure_policy: Retain every control and grid case; report any failure without changing the grid.
not_established: Coverage of an unknown original cohort
